as_told.title: FBI document on the UFO-nuclear connection

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1949 a memo, now public, was sent to J. Edgar Hoover, director of the FBI, the US federal police agency, reporting flying discs, flying saucers and so-called balls of fire. According to Michels, the memo says intelligence officers of both the Army and the Air Force treated the matter as top secret, and the story is tied to Los Alamos, New Mexico, where the atomic bomb was built. He tells it because, if true, it would show the government took such sightings seriously near its nuclear sites from early on.
